apps.name: Bulk AI
apps.subtitle: Dynamic, adherence-neutral nutrition tracker
apps.localizedDescription: Bulk AI tracks your weight trend with EWMA smoothing, computes your TDEE dynamically from real intake plus weight change, and proposes new daily targets every week via an adherence-neutral check-in. Forked from Fud AI (MIT). iOS only.

privacy.name: NSHealthShareUsageDescription
privacy.usageDescription: Read your weight, height, and body composition to keep your profile accurate.

privacy.name: NSHealthUpdateUsageDescription
privacy.usageDescription: Write your nutrition and body measurements so all your health data stays in one place.
